name: 60936 · Gibson City, IL
findings: ZIP 60936 (Gibson City) has 23 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 8 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (60% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60936 (Gibson City) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
38% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
